data.notes: 20-search budget used. No official Mercedes press kits (media.mercedes-benz.com / Daimler archive) surfaced in search results; values come from consistent secondary databases (mobile.de, angurten.de, autokosten.net), Mercedes press text quoted on mbpassion.de, and ADAC Autokatalog for AMG/facelift. Facelifts (W176 2015, W169 2008, W205/S205 2018, W204/S204 2011, W203 2004) were not split because dimension changes are minor/unconfirmed; details in notes.

verification.notes: 19 WebSearch calls used. S204 T-Modell widthMm 1770 mm CONFIRMED by angurten.de S204 page (https://www.angurten.de/is/abmessungen/173-C-Klasse+T-Modell: Laenge 4596 mm, Breite ohne Spiegel 1770 mm, 485/1500 l). Confirmed: W176 4292/1780/1433/2699, 341/1157 (ADAC facelift A 180 also 341/1157, 1780, 1433, 2699); W169 3838/1764/1593/2568, 435/1370 (ADAC facelift same except length 3883); W205 4686/1810/1442/2840, 480 l (W205 facelift 455 l not found anywhere, 480 stands); C 350 e sedan 335 l (mbpassion press data); W204 4581/1770/1447/2760, 475 l (angurten); W203 4526/1728/1426/2715, 455 l (auto-data); S205 4702/1810/1457/2840, 490/1510 (mbpassion premiere press, ADAC C 220 d pre-facelift); S205 C 63 T 4771/1839/490/1510 (ADAC); S203 4541/1728/1465, 470 l; S203 folded 1354 l supported by ADAC facelift C 230 T (480/1354) and Auto Bild (470-1354), auto-data says 1384 l - kept 1354. Not resolved: W205 C 300 e sedan trunk (315 l only from dealer/portal sources, possibly W206-confused - not corrected); S204 height/wheelbase not independently checked; W204 C 63 sedan length conflicting (4.58 m vs 4726 mm). All confirmations come from secondary databases/ADAC; no direct Mercedes press kit retrieved.
